name: print-social-black-and-neon-lime-agency-post-grid-nova-studio
title: Small mosaic of black, lime and cream studio posts with heavy condensed type and portrait cutouts
whatItIs: A pin preview of nine to twelve portrait posts for a studio: black cards with lime headlines ('SYSTEM BUILT. BRAND ELEVATED.'), lime cards with black type ('YOUR WEBSITE IS YOUR SYSTEM.'), cream cards, laptop mockups, a countdown, episode covers and a brief call to action.
whatItMeans: Bold and startup-like; lime and black feel like a signal.
techniques: Alternate black, lime and cream cards.
Mix laptop mockups with portrait cutouts.
Add countdown and episode cover formats.

vocabulary.definition: A grid overview of many posts.
A cover for a series episode.
A call to start a project brief.
